assertions.description: The target claim's status in MY CLAIMS reads Pending approval, i.e. it is in the approval queue rather than still Draft.

assertions.value: This claim cannot be submitted yet:
assertions.description: No unresolved validation banner remains, so nothing still blocks the claim from submission (e.g. a missing category or a cost center required for claims over 500).

The Pending approval status must be re-read in a freshly opened or reloaded claim view to distinguish a saved submission from a transient one; the assertion language cannot perform that reopen, so the agent must do it and confirm the status persists with the claim read-only and the submitted-to footer shown.
